text:
sam-support: Heads up — BrightCo reported autopay failure for 2026-03 invoice. Charge returned DECLINE: insufficient_funds, then in retries acquirer returned 2003 (suspected_fraud). Customer saw 3DS challenge redirect loop. Logs + repro below.

sam-support: Repro steps:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/payments/charge \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." \
  -d '{"amount": 12500,"currency":"usd","card_token":"tok_abc","merchant_id":"brightco"}'
```

sam-support: x-request-id=9f7d3a, request latency ~820ms first try, then 5xx timeout on retry.

priya-payments: Looking. Can you paste the full event payload? any acquirer reference?

sam-support: Pasted acquirer response: `decline_code=insufficient_funds; acquirer_code=2003; acquirer_message="SUSPECTED_FRAUD"; 3ds_status=challenge_required; acs_url=https://acs.bank/redirect; 3ds_flow=iframe`.

marco-eng: The iframe loop usually points to cookie/third-party context. Any CSP or SameSite on merchant iframe? BrightCo uses embedded checkout in iframe.

jess-cs: Customer says their iframe shows spinner then reloads to our redirect URL repeatedly. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/test/brightco-3ds-loop.png

liam-sre: I pulled network trace — ACS POST returns 302 back to our redirect target with Set-Cookie SameSite=None; Secure present. Looks ok. But client blocked third-party cookie on Safari/IOS which causes state mismatch -> ACS rejects -> acs sends 302 -> client reload => loop.

priya-payments: So two issues: INF_FUNDS then acquirer flagged FRAUD on retry. For the iframe, fallback is to open 3DS in new tab/redirect, not iframe. BrightCo is embedded; need to switch to redirect flow when iframe failing. Suggest: mark this merchant for redirect fallback immediately.

marco-eng: Workaround: add header `x-3ds-fallback: redirect` for BrightCo while we coordinate with acquirer.

sam-support: Customer notified. Next steps: Priya to open escalation with acquirer (ref 9f7d3a), Marco to push temporary header flag, Jess to update BrightCo support doc with redirect fallback. Closing if actions done. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Escalation ticket created: ESC-2031234567 (acquirer case 9f7d3a).

priya-payments: On it — will update with acquirer ETA.
